import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Revenue by product (horizontal bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Revenue by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax1.bar_label(bars1, fmt='${:,.0f}', padding=3, fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by age group (pie chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax2.set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Average transaction value by payment method (bar chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
payment_avg = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars3 = ax3.bar(payment_avg.index, payment_avg.values)
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction by Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax3.bar_label(bars3, fmt='${:.2f}', padding=3, fontsize=9)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Revenue by size (stacked bar chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
size_product_revenue = df.pivot_table(index='size', columns='product', values='total', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
size_product_revenue.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax4, width=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Revenue by Size and Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax4.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in revenue comparison (grouped bar chart)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
takeaway_labels = {0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'}
df['takeaway_label'] = df['is_takeaway'].map(takeaway_labels)
takeaway_product = df.pivot_table(index='product', columns='takeaway_label', values='total', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
x = np.arange(len(takeaway_product.index))
width = 0.35
bars5a = ax5.bar(x - width/2, takeaway_product['Dine-in'], width, label='Dine-in')
bars5b = ax5.bar(x + width/2, takeaway_product['Takeaway'], width, label='Takeaway')
ax5.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Revenue by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax5.set_xticks(x)
ax5.set_xticklabels(takeaway_product.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax5.legend()

# 6. Quantity distribution by product (box plot)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
box_data = [df[df['product'] == product]['quantity'] for product in df['product'].unique()]
bp = ax6.boxplot(box_data, labels=df['product'].unique(), patch_artist=True)
ax6.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Quantity per Transaction', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Quantity Distribution by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(box_data)))
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
